comment: I’m out of Scheffler starts for Segment 2. Feels sub-optimal. But we work with what we have.

Bolton used this move on me last year, so I'm trying to repay the favor! With a new setup at TPC Craig Ranch, I will send the World No. 1, sleeping in his own bed this week, to do my bidding against a field that is not, ahem, as strong as the PGA Championship.
I haven’t gotten a victory from my captain since January. That captain was also Scottie Scheffler, also at a full-field event. It’s time.
Going back to the well here. He’s by far the best player in this field, and I trust he can get his putting back on track in the friendly confines of TPC Craig Ranch.

Going on a bit of a limb here, but I am confident in Hisatsune’s balanced game to continue to flourish. Feels like a week we get an up-and-coming winner, assuming Scheffler doesn’t take out any frustrations.
